changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO m_code_value (id, code_id, code_value, code_description, order_position, code_score, is_active, is_mandatory) SELECT nextval('m_code_value_id_seq'), code.id, requested.code_value, 'Required by Arissto client migration', requested.order_position, NULL, TRUE, FALSE FROM m_code code CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('masculino', 1), ('Femenino', 2)) requested(code_value, order_position) WHERE code.code_name = 'Gender' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM m_code_value existing WHERE existing.code_id = code.id AND ( (requested.code_value = 'masculino' AND LOWER(existing.code_value) IN ('masculino', 'hombre')) OR (requested.code_value = 'Femenino' AND LOWER(existing.code_value) IN ('femenino', 'mujer')) ) );

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM m_code_value value USING m_code code WHERE value.code_id = code.id AND code.code_name = 'Gender' AND value.code_value IN ('masculino', 'Femenino') AND value.code_description = 'Required by Arissto client migration' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM m_client client WHERE client.gender_cv_id = value.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM m_family_members member WHERE member.gender_cv_id = value.id);
